# Professional Description

P.E.S. Video Services is a Fresno-based legal video provider with nearly 40 years of expertise in professional deposition videography and legal video services. Since 1985, they have established themselves as a trusted partner for law firms, delivering excellence in capturing depositions and other legal proceedings with precision and professionalism. Their extensive experience and commitment to quality legal video documentation make them a dependable choice for attorneys throughout the Central Valley.
